title: 5.4.3 Side-Scrolling Platformer — Challenge
description: A multi-platform level with camera follow, a goal flag, and a win condition.

steps.title: Level geometry
steps.instructions: Build a level ~2000px wide with at least 6 static platforms at varied heights.
hints: Use a loop to scatter them, or list them explicitly.

steps.title: Player + controls
steps.instructions: Dynamic player. Left/Right move; Space jumps when on a platform (use colliding vs. any static).
hints: Track an onGround flag each frame by checking collision.

steps.title: Camera follow
steps.instructions: camera.x eases toward player.x each frame.

steps.title: Goal flag + win
steps.instructions: At the far right, a static flag sprite. When player.overlapping(flag), display 'You Win!' in draw.

requirements.title: Displays text
requirements.description: Calls text(...) to display a message
